note: Playable builds for the existing carIds. Research records remain unchanged. fti.note: Powerglide racing transmissions; package prices and torque capacities below are modeled.

vp.note: C16: MON 116, RON >120, SG 0.735, AFR 14.70, oxygen 0; modeled LHV and evaporation heat.
